name: Buzzbox 827
objectiveText: Collect 6 Crawler Legs and place them in Buzzbox 827 . Crawler Leg  ( 6 )

comments.body: 37,46 - Jumping distance from the platform with the hippogryph master

Buzzbox 827 is located near the flight master, in the grass. 
36 46

The Gnome questgiver is on the second floor of the inn, just up the ramp.

These quests also supply you with some good cooking ingredients, such as Crawler Meat and Claws, and Clam Meat. Plus the Gnomergan Exiles rep is pretty nice for such a low level quest thread.

This buzzbot was very hard to find. If you're stumbling around, he's almost directly at the south-west pier of the gryphon platform, just in the grass about 2-3 paces from the pier. He looks(especially in the dusk) just like a hillock of grass.
The crawler legs drop from the Pygmy Tide Crawlers
the buzzbox is at 37,46

Not a bad set of quests. When you complete all four you receive a total of 25 silver, 50 copper and 4300 XP.
